messages:
marco: Quick heads-up — I'm prepping the pre-cutoff lock bump for the release. Need an owner for the vendor/core version bump (v2.3) and submodule pointer update. I can open the PR but want a reviewer before merging.

jen: I can own the vendor/core bump. Planning to update the lockfile + submodule commit. Any known blockers?

sam: Heads-up — there's a grpc shim change in the dependency tree that may require a tiny BUILD tweak. I can help with that.

jen: Copy. I'll open the PR and tag you. Also can someone run vendor verification locally? I hit a checksum mismatch yesterday.

sam: Paste of the small diff I saw: ```diff
- deps/grpc v1.2.0
+ deps/grpc v1.2.1
```

marco: Note for changelog: please add an "infra: bump vendor/core -> v2.3" entry under Unreleased. Tia, can QA do a quick smoke after merge?

tia: Yep — I'll queue a quick smoke on staging once the PR is merged. Also remind me to run the inference-fastpath tests (they're flaky).

jen: release-bot, what's the cutoff window?

release-bot: Reminder from release calendar: prep window ends 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC, hard cutoff 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC. Merge or freeze before cutoff. :alarm_clock:

sam: Small gotcha — when you update submodules, run `git submodule sync` then `git submodule update --init`. I saw a checksum mismatch fixed by that.

jen: Good call. I'll include a short checklist in the PR description: 1) `git submodule sync` 2) `./scripts/vendor-verify.sh` 3) run target smoke tests locally.

marco: Plan: merge by EOD tomorrow if sam + tia sign off. If anyone needs an exception, speak now.

release-bot: Warning: cutoff in ~14 hours. Merge conflicts often show up near cutoff.

jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821 — title: "bump(vendor/core): v2.3 + lockfile + submodule". PTAL @sam @marco @tia

sam: Reviewing now. One inline comment about BUILD deps, otherwise LGTM.

marco: Thanks. Once CI is green and sam's BUILD tweak is in, I'll merge and coordinate the staging smoke with tia. :thumbsup:
